description: This file implements several accessor functions for manipulating and retrieving properties (syntax, content type, usage type) of SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) variable entities within the Slap Var Entity Object. It includes functions to get and set variable content types and usage types, as well as to retrieve variable syntax.

methods.name: ULONG SlapVeoGetVarSyntax(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Retrieves the syntax type of the first parameter in the provided parameter list, defaulting to 'other' if parameters are missing or invalid.

methods.name: ULONG SlapVeoGetVarContentType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the first parameter in the provided parameter list, defaulting to 'other' if parameters are missing or invalid.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapVeoSetVarContentType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Sets the content type of the target variable based on the second parameter, which can be a uint32 or string representing the content type.

methods.name: ULONG SlapVeoGetVarUsageType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Retrieves the usage type of the first parameter in the provided parameter list, defaulting to 'other' if invalid.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapVeoSetVarUsageType(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Sets the usage type of the target variable based on the second parameter, which can be a uint32 or string.
